title: Operation Moonwatch and its 36 UFO reports

tellings.quote: so Alan Heinek was helping Whipple in this program and they actually had 36 UFO report that I think Jacquali found that we now uh like also look through.

plain: Operation Moonwatch, a 1950s program run from Harvard that used a dozen tracking stations around the world to watch the sky, is said to have collected 36 UFO reports. The astronomer Beatriz Villarroel tells Michels that Fred Whipple ran the program with help from J. Allen Hynek, and that the reports were found, she thinks, by the researcher Jacques Vallée; her own team is now going through them. If the reports hold up, trained sky-watchers were logging unexplained objects alongside their regular work.
